snippet.title: Shadow Strikers Arena of Rivals — Beta Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Shadow Strikers: Arena of Rivals — Beta Gameplay Trailer | Meet the Fighters

Shadow Strikers: Arena of Rivals is back — bigger, faster, and more brutal.

This Beta gameplay trailer gives you a first look at the fighters of Arena of Rivals, the direct evolution of Shadow Strikers. Built from the ground up by a solo developer from Mozambique, the game features an expanded roster, reworked combat mechanics, new moves, and an immersive story set in the underground tournament scene of the mysterious city of Shadow Waven.

⚠️ This is a Beta build. The full release is planned for the second half of 2026.
